config.source:
SELECT 
  p.company_id,
  c.company_name,
  p.recruitment_fee_amount,
  YEAR(p.joining_date) AS year
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_placement p LEFT JOIN recruitment.silver.dim_company c ON p.company_id = c.company_id

SELECT 
  job_id,
  job_title,
  company_id,
  job_status,
  job_priority,
  job_location,
  job_open_date,
  DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), job_open_date) AS days_open,
  YEAR(job_open_date) AS job_year,
  MONTH(job_open_date) AS job_month
FROM recruitment.silver.dim_job

measures.name: open_jobs
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN job_status = 'Open' THEN job_id END)

config.source:
SELECT 
  'Submissions' AS stage,
  1 AS stage_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT submission_id) AS count
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_submission
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Interviews' AS stage,
  2 AS stage_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT interview_id) AS count
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_interview
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Offers' AS stage,
  3 AS stage_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT offer_id) AS count
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_offer
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Placements' AS stage,
  4 AS stage_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT placement_id) AS count
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_placement

SELECT 
  p.placement_id,
  p.job_id,
  p.candidate_id,
  p.company_id,
  p.joining_date,
  p.annual_ctc,
  p.recruitment_fee_amount,
  p.recruitment_fee_percentage,
  j.job_open_date,
  j.job_title,
  j.job_priority,
  c.company_name,
  DATEDIFF(p.joining_date, j.job_open_date) AS time_to_fill_days,
  YEAR(p.joining_date) AS placement_year,
  MONTH(p.joining_date) AS placement_month,
  DATE_FORMAT(p.joining_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS placement_year_month,
  QUARTER(p.joining_date) AS placement_quarter
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_placement p LEFT JOIN recruitment.silver.dim_job j ON p.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN recruitment.silver.dim_company c ON p.company_id = c.company_id

measures.name: ytd_placements
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN placement_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) THEN placement_id END)

measures.name: ytd_revenue
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN placement_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) THEN recruitment_fee_amount END)

measures.name: active_candidates
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN candidate_status = 'Active' THEN candidate_id END)

config.source:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_submission) AS total_submissions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_placement) AS total_placements

SELECT 
  o.offer_id,
  o.candidate_id,
  o.job_id,
  o.offer_date,
  o.offer_status,
  o.offered_ctc,
  YEAR(o.offer_date) AS offer_year,
  MONTH(o.offer_date) AS offer_month
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_offer o

measures.name: accepted_offers
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN offer_status = 'Accepted' THEN offer_id END)

measures.name: rejected_offers
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN offer_status = 'Rejected' THEN offer_id END)

config.source:
SELECT 
  s.submission_id,
  s.job_id,
  s.candidate_id,
  s.submission_date,
  j.job_title,
  j.company_id,
  c.company_name,
  YEAR(s.submission_date) AS submission_year,
  MONTH(s.submission_date) AS submission_month,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.submission_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS submission_year_month
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_submission s LEFT JOIN recruitment.silver.dim_job j ON s.job_id = j.job_id LEFT JOIN recruitment.silver.dim_company c ON j.company_id = c.company_id

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_submission) AS submissions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_interview) AS interviews,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_offer) AS offers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruitment.silver.fact_placement) AS placements

SELECT 
  i.interview_id,
  i.submission_id,
  i.scheduled_ts,
  i.completed_ts,
  i.interview_round,
  i.interview_type,
  i.interview_status,
  i.result,
  i.job_id,
  i.candidate_id,
  YEAR(COALESCE(i.completed_ts, i.scheduled_ts)) AS interview_year,
  MONTH(COALESCE(i.completed_ts, i.scheduled_ts)) AS interview_month
FROM recruitment.silver.fact_interview i

measures.name: completed_interviews
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN interview_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN interview_id END)

measures.name: passed_interviews
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN interview_id END)

measures.name: failed_interviews
measures.expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN result = 'FAIL' THEN interview_id END)
